class.name: NetwPropertySetColumn
class.brief_description: One member column of a [NetwPropertySet], positioned in wire order inside [member NetwPropertySet.columns].
class.description: What the column holds is read from [member schema_column], the schema's own declaration, so a set never carries a second copy of a key or a quantizer that could disagree with the table and the database. Everything else here says how the column travels and what a correction does with it.

method.name: create
method.description: Builds a member whose shape is a fresh single-column declaration. A set compiled from a declaration passes its column through [member schema_column] instead, so this form is for a set assembled by hand with no schema of its own.

members.member: The sibling column a recovery advances this value along, from the transition it acknowledged to the present, or empty when the acknowledged value is written as it stands.
How firmly a restored value is pulled toward the authoritative one instead of being written to it, or [code]0.0[/code] to write it outright.

Whether the column spends a per-element selector to write a signed step from the baseline its frame names, or writes its whole code every time. [constant DELTA_AUTO] derives the result from the declaration, and the derivation is the measured one: a ladder pays 39 to 71 percent on a value a solver integrates and costs 12.5 percent on one a player authors or one that wraps, so it is taken only for a quantized column wider than eight bits on a set whose [member NetwPropertySet.record] is [constant NetwPropertySet.RECORD_STATE], and never for a [NetwQuantizeAngle]. Override it where the declaration cannot see what the value does. An integrated column on a set that is not state is one such case, and an authored one whose declaration looks integrated is the other. A column narrower than five bits is [constant DELTA_FULL] whatever this says, because no bucket is narrower than the code it would replace. The result is part of [method NetwPropertySet.wire_hash], so builds with different layouts reject the connection.
The column's own divergence threshold, or a negative value to inherit the entity's default.
When [code]true[/code] the column never triggers a correction on its own, while a correction another column triggers still restores it.
When [code]true[/code] the column is restored only by a teleport-tier recovery, never by an ordinary one.
Payload name, stable across peers because both read it off the same declaration.
The delivery lane, the axis form of [member watch].
What the column's value does in the simulation, which decides whether a reconciliation compares it, restores it, or leaves it to display.

Bit-packer for this column, or [code]null[/code] for a self-describing raw [Variant] on the wire. Part of the schema's shape, so two peers that packed it differently disagree on [method NetwPropertySet.wire_hash].
The address this column has in the schema its set was declared from, the one address it has anywhere.
The column's own teleport-tier distance, or a negative value to inherit the entity's default.
The declared [NetwMultiplayer] column type fixed into the schema.
When [code]true[/code] the column replicates reliably on change, otherwise it is volatile and freshest-wins.

constants.constant: The core derives [member delta_mode] from the declaration.
Every element writes its whole code, which is what a peer holding no baseline can read.
Every element writes a two-bit selector and either its whole code or a signed step in the smallest bucket that holds it.
